name: Jan Veselý
bio:
Jan's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, attending local rally events with his father. This early exposure fueled his desire to combine his marketing skills with his love for racing. After completing his degree in marketing, Jan sought opportunities to enter the motorsport industry. He possesses a keen understanding of digital marketing strategies and a dedication to creating engaging content that resonates with fans and sponsors alike.

He is eager to learn from experienced professionals and contribute to a team's success. Jan is particularly interested in developing innovative marketing campaigns that leverage social media and other digital platforms to enhance brand awareness and drive fan engagement. He believes in a collaborative approach and values open communication to achieve the best possible results.

Jan's loyalty and strong work ethic make him a valuable asset to any team. He is always willing to go the extra mile to ensure that projects are completed to the highest standards. He aspires to become a leading marketing strategist in the motorsport world.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly styled with a slight wave
physical.description: Jan is of average height, with a focused and friendly demeanor.
